coverage_decisions.decision: Compare urban processes and employment; correct urbanisation to rising urban proportion, not simply people moving. Do not equate all self-employment or temporary work with informal work.
Use broad uneven-development and urban-challenge concepts; retain Salford and Leeds instead of adopting source cities or outdated city-status/population claims.

decisions: OCR A controls coverage; other-board examples and old programme claims were not imported. Preserved every Salford and Leeds case-study paragraph, dated statistic and diagram.
Filled the specification gap for named UK trading partners using a verified DBT/ONS 2025 total-trade snapshot; distinguished goods/services and imports/exports.
Expanded economic-change, inequality and DTM reasoning, and distinguished ethnicity from development ranking. Added dated migration evidence with the correct population scope.
Kept existing flat three-group menu; revised material remains with related explanations.
